rawContent: Thanking God that #JacobBlake is alive -- but in no state, no country, no world should he be paralyzed. What happened in Kenosha is similar to what has happened far too many times in this country. It's an atrocity. Shame on the officer and anyone defending him #BlackLivesMatter

Good morning to everybody except those of you who can’t fix their mouths to say that racism is persistent, systemic, and wrong — and that #BlackLivesMatter

Change is coming.

To those marching today, be vigilant. And know that there’s a safe haven at 9th and V St NW (@930Club)!
